content.comment_body: Hi! I'm having an issue with the [product_name] display. It's only showing 'Card mode', and the usual 'PC/Card mode' option is missing. I need that mode to connect the module to my PC.

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. With the [article_no], there isn't a selectable menu for transferring the program between your PC and the [product_name]. You need to use the transfer function directly from the [product_name] software.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing confusion due to the lack of a 'PC/Card mode' selection on the [product_name] display for [article_no] modules. While users expect this mode for connecting to a PC, the forum clarifies it's not available in this hardware version and advises initiating transfers directly from the software. This has led to uncertainty regarding how to connect the module to the PC across different revisions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an easily accessible 'PC/Card mode' option on the [product_name] display to streamline program transfer to a PC.
